name: fluidlayer domain prior

contents.codebook: prototypes (M x d) fp16 -- the static geometry
contents.fluid_state: anchors (M x r) fp16 -- the constant-size gist
contents.landmarks: exact token spans at the persistent structural classes

guarantees: a frozen slot's value is bit-identical to the source token id
the serialized frozen register is append-only; it is not tamper-evident
the runtime state is constant size -- it never grows with input
not_guaranteed: verbatim recall of text that is not in the landmark table
